_comment: Pixel positions in data/derived/scans/tnd6853-fig3a.png of each labeled body's glyph (not its text). approxPx is read by eye from tmp/fig3a-blobs.png and snapped to the nearest detected blob within 20 px. manualPx is used as-is for glyphs that touch the frame line or the reticle (Sirius, Navi, Venus, Saturn), measured on a 4× zoom (±1.5 px ≈ ±0.2°).
